# Documentation instructions

Follow `.ai/primitives/rules/documentation-system.md`.

Keep documentation synchronized across `docs/`, `vault/`, `.ai/context`, `.ai/primitives` and IDE/CLI adapters. New PoCs need README + `vault/03-PoCs` + inventory. New decisions need ADR + index. New reusable concepts need `vault/04-Concepts` + MOC links.
